chunks.text: After a version is submitted successfully, the system creates a new version and releases the edit lock; a failed submission keeps the lock and does not complete the version transition.

Text-layer PDF, DOCX, PNG and JPEG are supported. Scanned files attempt OCR; recognised key values stay marked for human verification. Unsupported types must be rejected explicitly, never treated as success.
Version history is stored locally in this browser. Entries keep both the rich document and its projected text; restoring an old version does not rewrite history, it loads an unsaved draft.
The audit panel's 'no findings in checks that ran' is not a statement that the document is lawful or compliant; checks that did not run must be shown differently from checks that ran cleanly.
The editor supports paragraphs, three heading levels, bold, italic, underline, lists, tables, undo/redo and find/replace; the audit reads a deterministic plain-text projection.

Application documents usually include the application form, underlying contract, business licence, authorisation documents and AML information. Incomplete applications are returned for completion and re-enter approval.
Fees depend on the guaranteed amount, tenor, customer rating and country risk; issuance, amendment and cable charges are billed separately, subject to the quotation and tariff.
Extension or increase requires a written request and new approval materials; after approval the amended guarantee text governs, and fees and limit usage are adjusted.

A claim requires a written claim notice, supporting statement, evidence of default and a calculation of the claimed amount; incomplete claims are returned for correction and are not treated as accepted.
After expiry, applicant cancellation or a beneficiary release notice, the bank may cancel the guarantee and release cash or credit lines; no outstanding claim may remain.
With complete documents and approval, issuance normally takes three to five business days; cross-border guarantee registration, sanctions review or missing documents may extend it.

Common rejection reasons include amount or currency mismatch, wrong beneficiary name, missing expiry date, wrong contract number and incomplete signatures or seals; all corrections should be listed at once.
